title: GeNRe: A French Gender-Neutral Rewriting System Using Collective Nouns

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of rule-based and neural language models on the task of gender rewriting, specifically replacing masculine generics in French text with gender-neutral collective nouns. The system's ability to neutralize gender is measured using Word Error Rate (WER), BLEU scores, and cosine similarity against manually gender-neutralized reference sentences, alongside detailed manual and automated error analyses.
